summary: Default platform and extension informational goals catalog (Epic #218 / Feature #222)

entries.migration_impact: New and existing PLATE projects now get an expanded, versioned set of default informational goals (5+ platform defaults) via the baseline catalog. These seed Questions in bootstrap and are included by the Information Audit engine. Extensions can contribute via the catalog (future #226). The catalog is queryable via MCP (plate_informational_goals / plate_informational_goal).
entries.agent_notes: Use plate_informational_goals (or plate_informational_goal <id>) to inspect defaults. The audit tool (plate_perform_information_audit with include_defaults=true) will now pull from this catalog for proposals grounded in the #220 model. Bootstrap uses it for initial Questions. See yml for structure and extension guidance.
